quote: The identity work was exactly what we hoped for and nothing we expected. Restrained, confident, and it still looks right three years on.
name: Elena Marsh

quote: Rare to find a designer who can hold a whole editorial system in their head. The journal has never looked better, and production got easier, not harder.
name: Tomas Reeve

quote: Briefed on a Monday, first round on the Thursday, and it was already close. Sharp thinking, zero drama, on budget.
name: Priya Raghavan

quote: Our wayfinding used to confuse people daily. Now visitors just move. That is the whole review.
name: Daniel Okafor
